summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Dynamic Excel Dashboard. All core features working: demo data loading, visualizations (bar/pie/line charts), interactive filtering, data preview table, and chart customization controls.

ui_bugs.issue: Cannot select dates from calendar popup - date elements not selectable

integration_issues.issue: Emergent badge overlay intercepts click events on Upload New File button
integration_issues.workaround: Force click works to bypass overlay

passed_tests: Landing page loads with upload zone and demo button
Demo data loads 100 sample sales records successfully
Dashboard displays 6 metric cards with calculated values
Bar chart shows Distribution by Category (Region breakdown)
Pie chart shows Proportion Analysis (Region share)
Line chart shows Trend Over Time based on Date column
Data Preview table displays first 10 rows correctly
Filter bar shows date column selector, date pickers, and attribute filters
Category and Value dropdowns change chart data dynamically
Region filter dropdown filters data correctly
Clear filters button resets all filters
Charts update in real-time when filters change
Client-side Excel processing with xlsx library works
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix calendar date picker selection and resolve overlay click issue on Upload New File button. Both are minor UI issues that don't affect core functionality.
success_percentage: frontend: 95% - All core dashboard features working, only minor UI interaction issues
